name: Mukashi Gravure Idol Datta Danchizuma
original_name: むかしグラビアアイドルだった団地妻
source:
Izumi Hinamori was once a pin-up star who graced the covers of top glamour magazines. Walking away from the spotlight years ago, she now lives an ordinary life in an apartment complex as a devoted mother of one. No one in her neighborhood recognizes her past, and she has long embraced the quiet domestic routine.

Her only real heartache is their financial strain. Money is too tight to grant her young son’s wish for a baby brother, and she can only watch helplessly as her exhausted husband burns out at work without making progress. More than anything, Izumi longs to be of help to the man she loves.
